job.title: People Partner

Our client is a highly regarded professional services organisation operating across Australia and New Zealand. Following a sustained period of growth, the business has expanded significantly in recent years, increasing its workforce to circa 1000 employees nationally. As the organisation continues to evolve, there is a strong focus on building capability, strengthening people practices and creating scalable frameworks that support a high-performing and connected workforce.

Growth in Perth, combined with continued investment in local support functions and shared services capability, has created the need for a dedicated People Partner to support the Western Australian business. With the Perth office approaching 100 employees and continuing to expand, this newly created role represents an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative People & Culture team during a significant period of growth.

As the People Partner, you will join a highly collaborative national People & Culture team while acting as the dedicated HR presence for the Perth office. Supporting a workforce of approximately 80-100 employees, you'll partner closely with senior leaders across a diverse portfolio, delivering both strategic and operational people support. 
This role offers a unique blend of autonomy and support. As the only Perth-based HR rep, you'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and employees locally, while remaining connected to an experienced team of People Partners and broader HR specialists nationally. 
Approximately 70% of the role is focused on business partnering activities, with the remaining 30% dedicated to contributing to broader people initiatives and projects across the organisation. This could include areas such as organisational change, employee experience, leadership development, workforce planning and future business growth initiatives.

About You
We're looking for a HR Business Partner or emerging People Partner who enjoys building strong relationships with leaders and wants to continue developing their partnering capability within a highly regarded professional services environment. You'll bring broad generalist HR experience, solid exposure to employee relations and performance matters, and the confidence to work with stakeholders across a diverse portfolio. Curious, collaborative and commercially minded, you'll enjoy balancing day-to-day people support with opportunities to contribute to broader projects and initiatives. Most importantly, you'll be someone who is keen to learn, values being part of a supportive team and is looking to build their career within a growing organisation known for developing its people.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing current Talent Acquisition processes, tools, systems and workflows and identifying opportunities to elevate and improve them
  • Partnering with leaders to improve recruitment capability and upskill hiring managers on best-practice hiring processes
  • Implementing strategies to reduce agency spend and strengthen direct sourcing capability

  • Building strong stakeholder relationships across operational sites 
About You

This is an opportunity for an experienced TA professional who enjoys both hands-on recruitment delivery and strategic improvement, working closely with leaders to strengthen hiring practices and build scalable talent processes.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong operational recruitment capability with a future-focused mindset and enjoys a "build" role where you can truly make an impact and elevate there existing TA function.

Beyond the implementation phase, you will take a strategic view of payroll governance, remuneration processes, workforce data and systems integration, ensuring the organisation is well-positioned for future growth and acquisition activity.

  • Drive process standardisation across multiple legacy operating environments.
  • Partner with HR, finance and business leaders to streamline workforce management practices.
  • Improve workforce reporting, systems integration and people data capability.
  • Develop scalable payroll and remuneration frameworks to support ongoing business growth.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to support strategic workforce and remuneration decisions.
About You
You are a commercially minded payroll, remuneration or HR systems professional who enjoys connecting people, processes and technology.

You will bring:
  • Strong experience across payroll, remuneration and governance.
  • Experience working with HRIS and payroll systems (Employment Hero experience highly regarded).

  • Experience establishing frameworks, controls and scalable processes.

  • Resilience, adaptability and comfort working within evolving environments.
